typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	RunLoadDate as timestamp (),
	RunLoadId as integer (),
	machineName as string (),
	productVersion as string (),
	versionBuild as string (),
	versionGUID as string (),
	versionMajor as string (),
	versionMinor as string ()
}

source(output(
		LogMessage as string,
		EndDate as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'Select cast( \'DW Load Ended\' as nvarchar(150)) as LogMessage ,EndDate = getdate()',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(MachineName = toString($machineName),
		ProductVersion = toString($productVersion),
		VersionBuild = $versionBuild,
		VersionGUID = toString($versionGUID),
		VersionMajor = $versionMajor,
		VersionMinor = $versionMinor,
		RunLoadDate = $RunLoadDate,
		RunLoadId = $RunLoadId) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		VersionBuild as integer,
		VersionMinor as integer,
		MachineName as string,
		EndTime as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		LogMessage as string,
		VersionGUID as string,
		VersionMajor as integer,
		ProductVersion as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		VersionBuild,
		VersionMinor,
		MachineName,
		EndTime = EndDate,
		LogMessage,
		VersionGUID,
		VersionMajor,
		ProductVersion)) ~> DSTLoadControllog
